title: Request whose free text contains the word 'offer'
author: seed

turns.text: need.request service_type=hospital.physiatry procedure=VIS-FIS priority=D request_id=xr-108 Potete farmi un offer per la settimana? Grazie

notes: The act word is the first word (need.request); a later word 'offer' in the sentence must not turn the request into an offer.
